unified_features.name: Email sign-in with cookie session
unified_features.rationale: Both apps sign users in by email; A's server session was chosen over B's JWT (B's key is hard-coded and tokens never expire). One identity system for both user bases.
unified_features.behaviour: POST /api/session with email and password; on success an http-only, secure, same-site session cookie holds the user id; wrong credentials return 401; DELETE /api/session signs out.
unified_features.improvements: 401 on failed sign-in (A dereferenced a null user); slow password hash; session secret from configuration only.

unified_features.name: Read a post
unified_features.rationale: Same job with different access rules; combined deliberately: B's public reading for published posts, A's status model for everything else.
unified_features.behaviour: GET /api/posts/:id returns a published post to anyone; a pending or rejected post only to its author or a moderator, otherwise 404.

unified_features.name: Create a post held for moderation
unified_features.rationale: A's version chosen from the create-post group because every post must reach the moderation queue; B's immediate publishing (M06) was dropped.
unified_features.behaviour: A signed-in member submits a body (length limit decided in compatibility); the post is stored with status pending and the author's id; 201 with the post.
unified_features.improvements: Server-side length validation with a 422 response instead of relying on the DB constraint.

unified_features.name: Moderation queue
unified_features.rationale: Only A has it; it is the core of A's loop.
unified_features.behaviour: Moderators list pending posts (oldest first) and publish or reject each; others get 403.
unified_features.improvements: Decision validated to publish|reject (422 otherwise); moderated_by and moderated_at recorded.

unified_features.name: Post list
unified_features.rationale: Both apps have a /posts screen; one is kept. Neither source shows a list endpoint, so it is designed fresh.
unified_features.behaviour: GET /api/posts lists published posts, newest first, paginated; the /posts screen shows them and links to each post.
